claim: Construct the actual whole arithmetic source domain and normality over a normal Noetherian coefficient domain R injecting into Q; derive genuine DVRs at every source height-one prime and actual relative cotangent frames at every source prime, using the original finite contact charts and signed roots.

obligations.name: Actual domain
obligations.required_input: The source must be the original monic four-root order, not an assumed normal component.
obligations.constructed_input: The actual polynomial coefficient map R[X]→Q[X] base-changes all four monic quotients to the original rational source. Freeness makes the inclusion injective; the already proved original rational source domain supplies domain structure.
obligations.justification: The actual polynomial coefficient map R[X]→Q[X] base-changes all four monic quotients to the original rational source. Freeness makes the inclusion injective; the already proved original rational source domain supplies domain structure.

obligations.name: Arithmetic base
obligations.required_input: Normality and DVR conclusions need a precise arithmetic coefficient domain.
obligations.constructed_input: R is a normal Noetherian domain with a specified injective algebraMap to Q; twists are actual units of R. Fraction-ring bases supply the injection automatically. No assertion that every coefficient ring satisfies these hypotheses is made.
obligations.justification: R is a normal Noetherian domain with a specified injective algebraMap to Q; twists are actual units of R. Fraction-ring bases supply the injection automatically. No assertion that every coefficient ring satisfies these hypotheses is made.

obligations.name: Index coverage
obligations.required_input: Every finite source prime must lie in a proved normal chart.
obligations.constructed_input: All four original contact localizations are used. The actual separation-unit identity gives an index avoiding any given prime; normality descends using the full principal cover. Infinity and bad coefficient primes are not included by this theorem.
obligations.justification: All four original contact localizations are used. The actual separation-unit identity gives an index avoiding any given prime; normality descends using the full principal cover. Infinity and bad coefficient primes are not included by this theorem.

obligations.name: Branch normality
obligations.required_input: The actual localized branch orders must be domains and normal with the correct coefficients.
obligations.constructed_input: The source localization domain is derived from the whole source. The actual sourceLocalizationEquiv identifies it with the finite etale three-root order. Its base is a localization of the actual root-coordinate polynomial ring over normal R. Smooth integral-closure comparison proves normality.
obligations.justification: The source localization domain is derived from the whole source. The actual sourceLocalizationEquiv identifies it with the finite etale three-root order. Its base is a localization of the actual root-coordinate polynomial ring over normal R. Smooth integral-closure comparison proves normality.

obligations.name: DVR hypothesis production
obligations.required_input: Height-one valuation rings cannot remain supplied abstract rings.
obligations.constructed_input: Finite freeness over R[X] gives Noetherianity, principal-cover descent gives normality, and actual rational injection gives domain structure. HeightOneDVR.localization is applied to the actual original source prime with its stated height=1.
obligations.justification: Finite freeness over R[X] gives Noetherianity, principal-cover descent gives normality, and actual rational injection gives domain structure. HeightOneDVR.localization is applied to the actual original source prime with its stated height=1.

obligations.name: Scalar and localization maps
obligations.required_input: The cotangent frame must live on the same original prime localization.
obligations.constructed_input: The branch-to-prime map is the canonical localization map for powers(D_i)⊆P.primeCompl. Exact source and R scalar-tower identities identify the actual R action, and further localization of the original branch frame gives the prime frame.
obligations.justification: The branch-to-prime map is the canonical localization map for powers(D_i)⊆P.primeCompl. Exact source and R scalar-tower identities identify the actual R action, and further localization of the original branch frame gives the prime frame.

obligations.name: Signed root and downstream identity
obligations.required_input: A numerical free rank is not an actual normalized differential frame.
obligations.constructed_input: The chosen frame sends D of the actual original signed source root, mapped into the same prime ring, to1. The final height_one_geometry joins the actual DVR and the produced frame without either as a caller hypothesis.
obligations.justification: The chosen frame sends D of the actual original signed source root, mapped into the same prime ring, to1. The final height_one_geometry joins the actual DVR and the produced frame without either as a caller hypothesis.

obligations.name: Boundaries
obligations.required_input: Do not infer all arithmetic places, properness, or regular bad fibers from good finite charts.
obligations.constructed_input: The statement covers all height-one primes of the whole finite source over the explicitly good arithmetic base, not infinity or coefficient primes where separationInteger is nonunit. Base/model specialization, all-place metric/height comparison and bad-prime geometry remain separate. Existing48 original-section producers are retained unchanged.
obligations.justification: The statement covers all height-one primes of the whole finite source over the explicitly good arithmetic base, not infinity or coefficient primes where separationInteger is nonunit. Base/model specialization, all-place metric/height comparison and bad-prime geometry remain separate. Existing48 original-section producers are retained unchanged.

obligations.name: Validation and history
obligations.required_input: Preserve actual source contracts and independent acceptance boundaries.
obligations.constructed_input: All48 previous source files are copied exactly, including the current shared CommonBase repair. Four new modules apply accepted actual normality, height-one and localized-frame producers with their precise hypotheses. No local Lean; static checks and independent review do not imply kernel acceptance.
obligations.justification: All48 previous source files are copied exactly, including the current shared CommonBase repair. Four new modules apply accepted actual normality, height-one and localized-frame producers with their precise hypotheses. No local Lean; static checks and independent review do not imply kernel acceptance.
